answer_text:
Here is how you can log in to your **Wells Fargo Credit Card** account:

---

## 🔐 Wells Fargo Credit Card Login

### 🌐 Option 1: Login via Website
1. Go to the official Wells Fargo website: **[www.wellsfargo.com](https://www.wellsfargo.com)**
2. On the homepage, you'll see the sign-in section where you can enter your username and password.
3. Enter your username and password in the appropriate fields, then click **"Sign On"** to access your online account.

---

### 📱 Option 2: Login via Mobile App
Wells Fargo also provides a mobile banking app available for both Android and iOS devices. The app offers a fast and secure way to complete your login from anywhere.

1. Download the official Wells Fargo Mobile app from your device's app store, open the app, enter your username and password, and tap **Sign On**.
2. You can also enable **biometric authentication**, such as fingerprint or facial recognition, for quicker access.

---

### 📋 Once Logged In, You Can:
After you've signed in, you'll be able to manage your Wells Fargo credit card account online — including paying your credit card bill, viewing statements, monitoring account activity, and changing account information such as passwords and automatic payments.

---

### 🆕 First Time? Enroll Online:
If you don't already have an account, click **"Enroll"** and enter your card number, birthdate, and your Social Security number or Tax ID number to verify your credit card account.

---

### 🔑 Forgot Your Password?
If you forget your login information, you can reset or retrieve your username or password by clicking **"Forgot username or password?"** on the Wells Fargo login page and following the prompts.

---

> ⚠️ **Security Tip:** Always ensure you are on the **official website** before entering your login details to protect your financial information.

**Direct Login Link:** 👉 [https://www.wellsfargo.com](https://www.wellsfargo.com)
